import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_86/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_86/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_86/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_86/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_86/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# All sources have the same schema and match the target schema, so we union (concat) them
df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3, source4], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure column order matches target schema exactly
target_columns = ['titulo', 'tipo', 'precio', 'condicion', 'ubicacion', 'tiempo', 'reputacion', 'pago']
df = df[target_columns]

# Convert 'precio' to float explicitly (some sources have int)
df['precio'] = pd.to_numeric(df['precio'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Strip leading/trailing whitespace from string columns to match target formatting
for col in ['titulo', 'tipo', 'condicion', 'ubicacion', 'tiempo', 'reputacion', 'pago']:
    df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

# Save the final target table to the specified path
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
